facts.text: Maria finds peace through a combination of personal time, favorite music, and aerial yoga.

evidence.quote: Finding my Zen is a mix of things - a moment to myself plus favorite tunes is usually enough. I also enjoy aerial yoga, it's a great way to switch off and focus on my body.

facts.text: Maria enjoys upside-down yoga poses as they make her feel free and light.

evidence.quote: It's tough to pick just one, but I really enjoy the upside-down poses. They make me feel free and light.

facts.text: Maria appreciates the freedom and connection that aerial yoga provides.

evidence.quote: I love the freedom and connection it brings.
